content_blocks.label: clause_1._TERM_AND_RENT
content_blocks.text: The term of the Lease shall be for a period of three (3) years, commencing on March 1, 2024.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_RENTAL_AMOUNT
content_blocks.text: Monthly rent hereinafter due and payable in advance shall be in the amount of $1,200.00 per month.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._USE_OF_PREMISES
content_blocks.text: Tenant shall use the Premises solely for residential purposes, as further detailed in Exhibit A attached hereto.
